name: SUNMED
recent: Sunway Healthcare 近期完成多项企业活动：Putrajaya 医院联营协议签署、Velocity 医院物业收购转为无条件、槟城物业收购签署补充协议。同时，ESOS 行使持续新增上市股份，EPF 多次申报持股变动。
notable: 与 Putrajaya Holdings 子公司签署联营协议，在 Putrajaya 建设并租赁一家多专科私人医院。
以 RM228.5 million 收购 Sunway Medical Centre Velocity Tower A 的买卖协议于 2026 年 10 月 29 日转为无条件。
就 RM60.0 million 收购 Sunway Hotel Seberang Jaya 物业签署第一份补充协议。
risks: EPF 在 10 月至 11 月期间多次申报持股变动。
董事及首席财务官在公开交易期外行使 ESOS 期权。
ESOS 行使持续发行新股，最新一批 390,600 股于 2026 年 11 月 2 日上市。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度营收为 MYR 672.9 million，环比增长 14.6%，同比增长 29.8%；净利为 MYR 78.2 million，环比增长 134.5%，同比增长 88.9%；净利率为 11.6%，高于上一季度的 5.7%。

recent_en: Sunway Healthcare recently completed several corporate exercises: signed a JV agreement for a Putrajaya hospital, the Velocity hospital property acquisition turned unconditional, and a supplemental agreement was signed for the Penang property acquisition. Meanwhile, ESOS exercises continued to list new shares, and EPF filed multiple changes in shareholding.
notable_en: Signed a joint venture agreement with a Putrajaya Holdings subsidiary to construct and lease a multi-specialty private hospital in Putrajaya.
The SPA for the RM228.5 million acquisition of Tower A of Sunway Medical Centre Velocity became unconditional on 29 October 2026.
Signed a first supplemental agreement for the RM60.0 million acquisition of the Sunway Hotel Seberang Jaya property.
risks_en: EPF filed multiple changes in shareholding between October and November.
Directors and the CFO exercised ESOS options outside the closed period.
ESOS exercises continue to issue new shares, with the latest 390,600 shares listed on 2 November 2026.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 672.9 million, up 14.6% QoQ and 29.8% YoY; net income was MYR 78.2 million, up 134.5% QoQ and 88.9% YoY; net margin was 11.6%, higher than 5.7% in the previous quarter.
